name: Rotterdam Study / Rotterdam Scan Study (ERGO)
citation: Ikram MK et al. Retinal vessel diameters and cerebral small vessel disease: the Rotterdam Scan Study. Brain. 2006.
relation: Same parent cohort; Rotterdam Scan denominators and prospective stroke/dementia analyses overlap potentially; no pooling across publications.
participants: 490 paired retina and MRI in original CSVD analysis; separate 5,540 stroke-free retinal participants in incidence study; separate 2,436 with gradable images and MRI in diffusion study.
eyes: One eye per person for 490-person CSVD analysis.
multivisit: Yes (MRI follow-up and clinical surveillance); repeat retinal photos not established for each MRI subject.
multicenter: One district, Ommoord; population-based local cohort.
image_access: Study team acquired retinal images and MRI; exact externally provisioned raw files require scope confirmation.
label_access: Management team reviews requests; measures, event subtypes and dates in publications; obtain explicit field/format approval.
research_terms: Management approval under Dutch study privacy procedures; contact secretariat.epi@erasmusmc.nl per study team.
pairing: 1990–1993 digitized baseline fundus in one eye; MRI in 1995–1996 in 490 participants. Stroke-free 5,540 is from another analysis. Individual IDs/pseudonyms controlled.
strengths: 同一人眼底微血管、MRI 白质病灶与腔隙及事件随访有独立论文佐证。
limitations: 单地区、首轮≥55 岁；不同分析子集不等于同批患者。影像可否拿到像素与批准范围有关。
experiment: 以影像时间为起点，在有 MRI 的子集中回归白质病变等级，再在无基线卒中的事件队列检验增量预测及校准。

s1: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16317022/
Methods, 490 without dementia aged 60–90; one-eye digitized fundus then MRI; periventricular/subcortical lesions and lacunar infarcts.
s2: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16682664/
Methods, 5,540 age ≥55 with gradable photos and no baseline stroke; first-ever stroke followed through 2002, cerebral infarction evaluated.
s3: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21288987/
Methods and results: prospective fundus caliber, 11.6 years mean; 655 dementia, including diagnosed AD and vascular dementia.
s4: Data availability directs Rotterdam Study proposals to secretariat.epi@erasmusmc.nl, reviewed by management team; no raw retinal file entitlement stated.
s5: Methods: 2,436 participants aged ≥45 with gradable retinal images and brain MRI/diffusion, separate analysis.
s6: Mutlu et al., retinal OCT and dementia in Rotterdam Study; related analyses of same parent cohort.
s7: Erasmus MC, ERGO core facility. Prospective local cohort began 1990.

name: The Maastricht Study
citation: van der Heide FCT et al. Thinner inner retinal layers are associated with lower cognitive performance, lower brain volume, and altered white matter network structure. Alzheimers Dement. 2024 (online 2023).
relation: Multiple publications and partial visits/subsets from one parent study.
participants: 3,436 in OCT/cognition analysis; MRI only a subset. Separate fundus/brain white matter analysis includes 4,010; bilateral caliber measurements available in 54.7% of that analysis.
eyes: Fundus photos both eyes; before Nov 2013 caliber often one eye.
device: Nidek AFC-230 45°; 3T Siemens Prisma-fit for MRI.
image_access: Fundus/OCT pixels collected; study data request portal does not promise raw pixel export; specify raw images separately.
label_access: Research plan reviewed; published analyses use cognitive scores, brain morphometry and metabolic covariates.
research_terms: Formal proposal through portal; external researchers encouraged to work with management member/domain expert.
pairing: OCT thickness paired with global cognition; MRI introduced Dec 2013, subset only. Fundus caliber vs 3T connectivity separate. Request intersected denominator and exam dates.
strengths: 正式目录、申请入口；两项研究核实同人视网膜结构/血管与全脑指标。
limitations: 糖尿病超采样；MRI 非全体；横断面认知评分不能替代 AD 诊断。
experiment: 按糖代谢状态分层，评估 OCT 层厚与认知评分、MRI 灰白质体积，并在分析前规定两次采集允许的时间差。

s1: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37611119/
Methods: 3,436; age, sex, T2D oversampling; OCT layers linked to cognitive scores and MRI metrics; MRI subgroups vary by endpoint.
s2: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11056139/
Methods, retinal calibers and MRI: fundus camera/eyes; bilateral available for 54.7% of 4,010 analysis subjects; whole brain connectivity.
s3: https://www.demaastrichtstudie.nl/research/data-guidelines
Data guidelines: formal request with research plan; external investigator local collaboration encouraged.
s4: Portal directs users to searchable dictionary; check ownership and requested object type with management.
s5: Methods: 2,876 with retinal caliber and measured glucose status; office blood pressure, sex and age covariates; 176 photography visits substantially later.
s6: Methods, MRI available only in subset beginning December 2013.

多域认知评分；无 AD 病例依据。

dementia: 该研究未确认痴呆事件
followup: 队列前瞻，引用的眼脑分析横断面，未证实可追踪该分析集神经结局

name: Rhineland Study / Rheinland Studie
institution: German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE), Bonn
citation: Mauschitz MM et al. Retinal layer assessments as potential biomarkers for brain atrophy in the Rhineland Study. Sci Rep. 2022.
participants: First 5,000; 3,505 MRI, 3,395 MRI and SD-OCT; 2,872 final complete-case after exclusions; 2,797 with selected diffusion measures.
device: Heidelberg Spectralis SD-OCT; MRI and diffusion sequences.
quality: OCT signal ≥20 dB; missingness, neurological and retinal conditions excluded.
image_access: DUAC accepts image-database requests; raw/minimally processed files for QC or method development.
label_access: QC research database separately requestable; specify fields and join in protocol.
research_terms: Consent coverage and data minimization; research collaboration normally required; review purpose against raw image database rules.
pairing: Community participants seen in Bonn; same participant OCT and MRI; no universal denominator across diffusion and structural indices.
strengths: 有精确的 MRI/OCT 交集及排除流程，适合评估完整病例选择偏倚。
limitations: 本项分析排除了自报卒中，结局为结构/扩散指标；不能据此做 AD 或卒中事件监督。
experiment: 在 2,872 人原始分析框架内比较视网膜层厚和年龄对海马/灰白质体积的增量解释度。

s1: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8854401/
Methods/Data analyses: SD-OCT+MRI overlap (3,395); age, sex, HTN, diabetes, BMI, smoking; scan QC ≥20 dB; analytical 2,872; stroke excluded.
s2: https://www.rheinland-studie.de/en/participation/rules-of-use/
Data Use and Access Policy §1 and introduction: DUAC; identifiable image vs QC research database scopes; minimization, consent, collaborative access.

name: Shanghai Diabetes Prevention Program (SDPP; DeepRETStroke subsets)
institution: Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital and study collaborators
citation: Jiang et al. A deep learning system for detecting silent brain infarction and predicting stroke risk. Nat Biomed Eng. 2025.
relation: SDPP-MRI and non-MRI SDPP are distinct analysis subsets of the same parent; other DeepRETStroke cohorts (including UKB and AREDS) remain separate.
participants: 782 SDPP-MRI for SBI detection; separate 29,160 in longitudinal non-MRI internal set for incident stroke.
images: 1,564 in 782 internal SDPP-MRI; 58,320 photos in separate 29,160 longitudinal subset.
quality: Study QC of retinal photographs; clinical reference MRI only in MRI subset.
image_access: Deidentified fundus photographs can be requested for non-profit use; raw MRI transfer not promised.
label_access: Related clinical information request reviewed by data management committee; verify release of dates and MRI grading field.
research_terms: Request T.Y. Wong (wongtienyin@tsinghua.edu.cn); institutional committee and formal DTA.
commercial_terms: Published request route limited to non-profit use.
pairing: Person-level fundus and MRI-defined silent brain infarction in SDPP-MRI; separate longitudinal non-MRI sample predicts incident stroke. Pseudo-labels in non-MRI sample are not MRI diagnoses.
strengths: 中国受试者的真值 MRI 子集可与单独的卒中随访分析区分。
limitations: 申请式分发；不保证原始 MRI。勿把筛查阳性或模型伪标签当作确诊卒中。
experiment: MRI 子集评估检出静默性脑梗死；在独立随访子集中检验首次卒中风险并报告校准及时间依赖 AUC。

s1: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12623247/

Fig 1 and Table 1; separate internal MRI and non-MRI samples; development workflow distinguishes MRI labels from pseudo-labels; Data availability requires committee + DTA for nonprofit fundus images/clinical data.
s2: https://pure.qub.ac.uk/files/642367133/Jiang_DL_DeepStroke_Silent_and_Clinical_Stroke_Nature_BME_2025.pdf
Figure 1 / Methods: 782 participants/1,564 fundus images MRI arm; 29,160/58,320 separate longitudinal arm; two eyes. Table 1 reports demographics and metabolic risks.

name: AlzEye
institution: Moorfields Eye Hospital / UCL / NHS Digital
citation: Wagner SK et al. AlzEye: longitudinal record-level linkage of ophthalmic imaging and hospital admissions of 353,157 patients in London, UK. BMJ Open. 2022.
relation: Distinct from UK Biobank; PD paper used AlzEye and UKB separately.
participants: 353,157 cohort members; 186,651 linked with an admission; retinal imaging available for 154,830 in published PD analysis denominator.
images: 2022 cohort profile reported 1,874,175 retinal photographs and 1,567,358 OCT images; updated INSIGHT overview reports >6M retinal images across project scope.
multivisit: Yes; clinic visits and national admissions.
multicenter: One NHS trust, multiple locations; not independent hospital cohorts.
image_access: Restricted to AlzEye team under cohort-specific contract; general INSIGHT SRE is not an external AlzEye dataset release.
label_access: Linked HES diagnoses and mortality held by team. PD study welcomes proposals to PI; no independent access.
research_terms: Collaborative enquiry via PI, not standard independent data request. Scope of source-specific contract controls.
pairing: Study team linked retinal images to HES via trusted third party using NHS identifiers. Counts of attendees, imaged participants and admitted patients differ.
strengths: 临床影像及住院诊断、死亡的链接已实现，英格兰长期监测。
limitations: 住院编码漏诊，医院就诊样本有选择性；对外不可独立取得既有链接。
experiment: 仅作为合作价值推荐；经同意后研究 PD 或痴呆住院诊断的发生，按时间剔除基线患病者并区分死亡竞争风险。

name: Ontario Neurodegenerative Disease Research Initiative (ONDRI), Foundational Study release 2.0
citation: Sunderland KM et al. Characteristics of the Ontario Neurodegenerative Disease Research Initiative cohort. Alzheimers Dement. 2022.
participants: 520 parent; retinal abstract reports 390 pRNFL and 387 macular participants including 43/42 external BEAM controls respectively, not all 520.
eyes: Both eyes; 769 pRNFL and 755 macular eyes including external controls in abstract.
quality: Q score <17 excluded, expert review and manual boundary correction.
multivisit: Yes; release baseline and longitudinal; repeat raw retinal image counts unverified.
multicenter: Yes; 14 participating Ontario labs across study, retinal coverage site-specific.
image_access: Raw neuroimaging plus tabular OCT retinal thickness are documented. Raw retinal OCT/fundus pixels are not confirmed in accessible release; ask Brain-CODE.
label_access: Controlled data portal lists disease strata, neuropsychology, MRI and retinal measurements by timepoint.
research_terms: Registration, Data Access Committee and Steering Committee approval.
pairing: SD-OCT documented for participants across AD/MCI, PD, cerebrovascular disease with stroke history, ALS, FTD. Cross-platform/timepoint packages; retinal paper includes additional BEAM controls. Obtain approved participant crosswalk and MRI/OCT overlap.
strengths: 跨疾病、纵向、多实验室；可先用受控的层厚和认知指标检验假设。
limitations: 公开说明明确原始脑影像和眼底派生表；未找到承诺交付原始视网膜像素。不能用全部 520 人作为确证的 OCT–MRI 交集。
experiment: 先以层厚表和病种、认知量表做分层分析；如需像素端到端训练，先向委员会单列原始 OCT 请求。

citation: Bissig D, Zhou CG, Le V, Bernard JT. Optical coherence tomography reveals light-dependent retinal responses in Alzheimer’s disease. NeuroImage. 2020. Dataset DOI 10.5061/dryad.msbcc2ftc.
relation: Zenodo record 4935639 mirrors Dryad; repeated/processed image objects and release versions are not new cohorts.
images: 432 .img files reported in EyeDataHub's deposit audit, include derived copies; not 432 independent acquisitions.
participants: 40 unique IDs in repository profile tables across experiments; AD experiment compares 14 early-onset AD and 14 age-matched controls.
eyes: Experiment 4 targets one retinal slice per participant; laterality across entire release unverified.
resolution: 3.89 μm isometric resampled pixels; 30° slice for experiments 1,3,4.
quality: Usage notes give per-experiment exclusions and manual processing.

commercial_terms: CC0 for dataset files; no separate commercial restriction identified.
